credits.title: the blue we touch
credits.overview: After years of drifting apart, two 29-year-old friends, Mitsu and Ayane, navigate the quiet frustrations of adulthood as their lives begin to intersect with new people. Through these subtle encounters, the unspoken hesitations and deeply hidden emotions within their hearts are finally given voice.
